title: MOCA search hit
description: What a search backend returns for one candidate match, before the search entry point resolves it into a citation record. Normative: spec/moca-reader-contract.md section 9.1.

digest.description: The digest of the package the hit was indexed from.

path.description: The node path relative to content/.

span.description: UTF-8 byte offsets into the node file.

score.description: Higher is a better match. Not comparable across backends.
